title: Goodreads Buddy-Read Completion Rate
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:book buddy_name=* completed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(completed="yes",1,0))) as matched by buddy_name
| eval a_completed_buddy_read_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_completed_buddy_read_pct
description: Measures the percentage of buddy-read attempts that end with a completed buddy read by buddy.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which buddy are helping or hurting buddy-read attempts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a completed buddy read` on `reading:book` events and summarize the hit rate by `buddy_name`.
visualization: Table of buddy with percentage of buddy-read attempts ending with a completed buddy read.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often a completed buddy read happens for each buddy so you can see where buddy-read attempts go smoothly or get stuck.
